about: Personas for scripts/consult_eval.py. `facts` are hidden from the agent: the simulated user reveals them only when asked. `experience` tells the judge who the audience was. Mostly beginners, because that is who gives up on a form-like bot.

scenarios.opening: hi i want to start aquaponics
scenarios.persona: A young man in Ouagadougou who saw aquaponics on YouTube. Never kept fish. Wants to sell some vegetables at the market. Types short, informal messages.

facts.water: borehole shared with neighbours, sometimes short in March-April

scenarios.opening: Bonjour, je veux faire de l'aquaponie chez moi
scenarios.persona: A schoolteacher in Bobo-Dioulasso who wants fresh vegetables and fish for her family. Has never done any farming.

facts.water: robinet de l'ONEA, parfois des coupures

scenarios.opening: 你好，我想在陽台做魚菜共生
scenarios.persona: An office worker in Taichung with a balcony. Wants a hobby system for herbs. Worried about smell and noise for the neighbours.

facts.space: 陽台大約 2 平方公尺

scenarios.opening: my uncle says fish and plants together can make money. how?
scenarios.persona: Someone with almost no background who answers 'I don't know' to anything technical. Needs choices, not open questions.

facts.space: don't know, some land behind the house
facts.water: don't know, there is a well

scenarios.opening: Size me a tilapia + lettuce raft system: 20 m2 grow area, water around 27C, I can spare 400 L/day.
scenarios.persona: Someone who already did their homework and wants numbers now, not a chat. Gets impatient if asked things they already said.

scenarios.opening: HELP my fish are all at the top gasping what do i do
scenarios.persona: Panicking owner of a small tilapia system. The pump stopped overnight during a power cut. Replies fast and short.

facts.cause: power cut last night, air pump off

scenarios.opening: my lettuce leaves are going yellow
scenarios.persona: Has a small media-bed system running for two months. Only knows pH from a cheap strip test.

scenarios.opening: can aquaponics actually make money or is it a hobby
scenarios.persona: A small trader thinking of investing savings. Cares about payback time and selling price. Sells at a local market.

scenarios.opening: I don't want fish, just plants in water. possible?
scenarios.persona: Vegetarian who dislikes the idea of keeping fish. Wants to grow salad greens on a rooftop.

scenarios.opening: Running 30 m2 DWC with tilapia at 28C, 500 L/day makeup. Want the fish:crop ratio that maximises protein.
scenarios.persona: An experienced operator who dislikes hand-holding. Wants the answer and the assumptions, nothing else.

scenarios.opening: we have light only some hours a day. can I still do this?
scenarios.persona: A farmer in a village with only a few hours of grid power a day, considering solar. Grows vegetables in soil today.

scenarios.opening: ammonia 1.5 today, nitrite 0.5. is that bad?
scenarios.persona: Has a running 2000 L system that is six weeks old. Measured with an API test kit this morning.

scenarios.opening: Mes poissons ont des taches blanches, c'est grave ?
scenarios.persona: Owner of a small clarias system near Banfora. Worried and wants to know what to do today.

facts.symptom: petits points blancs sur le corps, ils se frottent
facts.water_temp: a baissé ces derniers jours, environ 22
facts.new_fish: j'ai ajouté des poissons du marché la semaine dernière

scenarios.opening: what is the cheapest way to start
scenarios.persona: A student with very little money who wants to try on a small scale first, using recycled containers.

scenarios.opening: my tilapia stop eating every winter, what can I do
scenarios.persona: Hobbyist in northern Taiwan with an outdoor system. Winters get cold at night.

facts.water_temp: drops to about 15 at night in January

scenarios.opening: my water is very green
scenarios.persona: Has a sunny outdoor system with an uncovered fish tank. Not sure whether green water is dangerous.

scenarios.opening: besides aquaponics, what vegetables grow well in the hot season here?
scenarios.persona: A market gardener near Ouagadougou who is curious about aquaponics but mostly grows in soil today.

facts.season: March to May, very hot and dry

scenarios.opening: i have a small yard, what system should I build
scenarios.persona: A homeowner in Kaohsiung who wants food for the family and does not think in square metres.

facts.space: small yard, maybe like two parking spaces

scenarios.opening: I just filled my system with water yesterday, when can I add fish?
scenarios.persona: Just built a small system from a kit. Does not know what cycling is.

scenarios.opening: 做魚菜共生多久可以回本？
scenarios.persona: A retired engineer in Tainan considering a small commercial greenhouse. Asks about payback and labour.

facts.space: 溫室大約 100 平方公尺
